title: Forge frozen current-cohort calibration profile
description: A read-only calibration contract, not training authorization. Populate exact identities before registering a bounded diagnostic lane. Historical receipts and other seeds cannot fill cells.

criteria.description: Filename beside this profile; use the preregistered criteria-v1.json unless a new criteria revision is explicitly declared.

cohort.description: Exact output of experiments.forge.calibration.calibration_cohort(request, smoke_tasks + reference_tasks). Full protocol fixes seed 0 and named streams; source, runtime, prior, initializer, task/evaluation hashes and per-task compute are bound. Candidate mechanisms and view placement are excluded.
